text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo. A new day dawns in Palermo without Gemma. Gemma was the officer.
Gemma left a note behind: "they really think they're so clever, it's almost adorable in a pathetic way."

Sonnet and Terra were the killers, and they spent Day 1 steering the town toward Haiku, who was voted out as a citizen after shouting accusations at everyone. The turning point came on Day 2, when Sonnet kept pushing the room to ignore Luna's questions and Luna, the doctor, was voted out after being pinned as a stale case. Gemma, the officer, was killed on Night 2 after leaving a sneering note about the killers. The killers won, with Sonnet and Terra surviving alongside each other while Haiku, Gemma, Sol, and Luna did not.
